text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at the shopping mall, I overhear a conversation between three members of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So… Dober, Big Sis Ryan, what do you make of this taiyaki shop?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The taiyaki are really tasty! Thanks for bringing us along, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Heehee.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Geez, Bright. You're practically giddy with joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I've so been looking forward to the three of us going out together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan… Big Sis Ryan…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you mind feeding me a taiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're such a spoiled kid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ready? Say "Ahh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ahhh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Heehee, that was so scrumptious that I think I'd like another bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: S-stop that! You shouldn't do that kind of thing in public—everyone's staring! You're not even a child. And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.text: …Sorry for bumping into you.
